t: 曼努埃尔一世·科姆内诺斯接任他的父亲约翰二世·科姆内诺斯为拜占庭皇帝.
te: Manuel I Komnenos succeeds his father John II Komnenos as Byzantine Emperor.
dz: 曼努埃尔一世·科姆内诺斯接任他的父亲约翰二世·科姆内诺斯为拜占庭皇帝.
de: Manuel I Komnenos succeeds his father John II Komnenos as Byzantine Emperor.

t: 选举塞拉斯蒂内二世教宗后因诺森特二世去世.
te: Election of pope Celestine II following the death of pope Innocent II.
dz: 选举塞拉斯蒂内二世教宗后因诺森特二世去世.
de: Election of pope Celestine II following the death of pope Innocent II.

t: 随着"萨莫拉条约"的签署,莱昂和卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索七世承认葡萄牙为王国.
te: With the signing of the Treaty of Zamora, King Alfonso VII of León and Castile recognises Portugal as a Kingdom.
dz: 随着"萨莫拉条约"的签署,莱昂和卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索七世承认葡萄牙为王国.
de: With the signing of the Treaty of Zamora, King Alfonso VII of León and Castile recognises Portugal as a Kingdom.
